title: Rabbi Elazar bar Menachem
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1, folio 5b, where Rabbi Pinchas speaks in his name. He is likewise mentioned in Tanchuma, Emor 10, Bereshit Rabbah 41:3, and Vayikra Rabbah 27:1. At the end of Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 23, Rabbi Abbahu expounded that the Ocean is higher than the whole world; Rabbi Elazar bar Menachem said, “But is it not an explicit verse?” Hyman infers that he was Rabbi Abbahu’s contemporary.
